quotes.text: Brother Sidney Sperry noted, "This is a severe arraignment of [charges against] Zephaniah's own people and is truly prophetic. Israel has special privileges; hence responsibilities inevitably follow. A chosen people elects spiritual responsibilities, and when they choose to turn away from God their doom follows. Zephaniah's warning left no room for misunderstanding, particularly on the part of Israel's leaders
quotes.attr: The Voice of Israel's Prophets [Salt Lake City: Deseret Book Co., 1952], 386

The Lord will make her that halted a remnant; and gather her that was driven out and afflicted; and make her who was cast afar off, a strong nation; and will reign over them in Mount Zion from that time forth and for ever. Or, in other words, He will assemble the Natives, the remnants of Joseph in America; and make of them a great, and strong, and powerful nation: and he will civilize and enlighten them, and will establish a holy city, and temple, and seat of government among them, which shall be called Zion.
quotes.attr: Proclamation of the Twelve Apostles of The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints issued to the world, April 6, 1845
